alex: Heads up — PR #9319 is blocking tonight's hotfix cutover. Need two approvals before 22:00 UTC (~45m). CI is green but smoke had a flaky timeout earlier. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9319

maria: On it, will do a quick review in ~15m. If nothing surprising I'll approve.

jon: I can give an approve for code & tests, but I can't run a full smoke until later. pinging @tara for the second signoff.

tara: @jon ok I can take the smoke now — running `make smoke` against staging. Will post results in ~10.

release-bot: deploy-cutoff-bot — Cutoff scheduled at 22:00 UTC. Reminder: merges requiring 2 approvals will be blocked after cutoff.

tara: Smoke run output:
```
Running smoke tests...
embedding-service smoke: timeout on attempt 1
rerun: all smoke checks passed
```
Approving now. :white_check_mark:

jon: Thanks — confirmed, approving. :thumbsup:

alex: Awesome, thanks both. I'll merge once the final CI job finishes and monitor canaries. If anything looks off I'll initiate rollback. :pray:
